reason: 682/500 normal-oxfmt product lower bound before lifecycle. Approved split267 adapter +415 finalUI; operator/server carry-fixes now named.

LSC-2C: Public per-browser-profile choice primary/seat1/seat2 persists without role, side, membership or ownership grants. Per-match joined public choice/playerId binding is independent of the next-join preference; reload/reconnect preserves it. Strictly validate saved choice, binding and storage failures.

Mint seats only via existing local-seats action:mint and unchanged primary payload/route for primary; consume sanitized LocalSeatRequestError, distinguish 401 denial from 429 throttle with Retry-After, never auto-retry. Validate playerId/token/expiry agreement and preserve existing per-match bearer storage and verifier/scope/TTL semantics.

Passwords and private keys remain request-local, absent from React state, persistence, URLs, logs and error reflection. Pin every request URL, denied/throttled/unknown failures and secrecy with runtime tests; preserve all operator adapter behavior and outcome generations.

Explicit match forget/reclaim removes choice, joined binding and bearer; partial storage failure must not claim success. Renewal refuses silent replacement playerId and rechecks the joined match binding before bearer replacement; reprovision requires ordinary GM readmission. Export a four-minute pre-expiry threshold for prompted UI renewal.
LSC-2O: CF-LSC2OP-2: label or explicitly confirm re-provision of an active seat as identity rotation requiring GM readmission. Keep selected-seat targeting, request-local unnamed password refs, current-password/new-password purposes, minimum lengths and active-only Revoke.

CF-LSC2OP-7: after an unknown-outcome write (network/status 0 or server 5xx), refresh public seats before permitting any mutation resubmission. No blind replay or automatic write retry; failed refresh disables writes until explicit recovery. Both existing 409 codes retain refresh behavior and stable seat targeting.

CF-LSC2OP-3: distinguish not-revocable from generation-conflict in repository/service and expose sanitized NOT_REVOCABLE server code to the client. A fresh revoke of an absent/already-revoked seat at the matching generation gets the distinct error; stale generation and operation mismatch retain their own outcomes. Replay lookup remains first, preserving earlier successful operation generation.

Runtime RED, new discriminating mutants, owned service/repository/API/operator/store suites and B14/match-history guards must pass without weakening same-host Host/Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site, windows, lockout, CAS/atomic replay, secret redaction, revocation-next-mint or already-issued bearer lifetime. No schema/migration/primary-auth edits.
LSC-2: Ordinary shipped co-op entry chooses primary GM identity or either local seat; choice grants no role. Mount chooser, chosen mint/join and public per-match binding through the frozen adapter; primary host mint semantics stay unchanged. Use isolated profile storage and the existing per-match bearer store, never identity seeding, global active-row switching or manual token transfer.

Retain in-repo three-identity integration: two players plus non-playing GM obtain three distinct public playerIds on one loopback authority, stable across reload/reconnect, renewal and expired recovery. Prove guest reclaim with a new password: active-seat reprovision -> new playerId -> GM readmission -> ghost old membership retained until ordinary removal. CF-LSC2OP-2 UI fix is predecessor proof, not a waiver of this sequence.

Mount renewal/expired recovery through CampaignNavigation for dashboard/missions/launch/starmap/log/personnel; cover primary GM and guest bearers. Prompt within the canonical four-minute pre-expiry window; never auto-mint/retry. Close/reconnect the transport or explicitly reload with the renewed bearer; storage-only replacement is insufficient.

Refuse silent mid-session identity replacement and direct explicit forget/reclaim; clear choice, match binding and bearer, preserve role/membership checks. Use uncontrolled unnamed type=password refs, clear immediately before await on success/error, preserve current-password/new-password. Distinguish denial and throttle/Retry-After with sanitized errors and secrecy tests.

Preserve same-host trust disclosures, operator/shared-OS impersonation risk, local-seat lifetime and revocation effective at next mint/renewal with old bearer lifetime retained; no immediate eviction claim. Consume CF-LSC2OP-7 predecessor refresh/no-blind-replay behavior; final integration cannot bypass unknown-outcome recovery.

Preserve CF-LSC1S-4, CF-LSC1-3/4/7, CF-LSC0-1/2/3/4/7/10/12/13/14 and CF-S-8 as routed, including primary/verifier parity, fresh census, real windows and later reseat work. Packaged/installed-server three-seat journey, password-manager/autofill verification and release proof stay mandatory in LSC-2P; no packaged acceptance is claimed here.

Every original LSC-2 behavior/acceptance remains mandatory through C/O predecessor proof plus final ordinary UI integration. LSC-2 keeps its id and every downstream edge; LSC-2/LSC-2P exact-main closures, H/P2/U38/P2J/installer/human gates and salvage ownership remain unchanged.

Preserve accepted current-password/new-password attributes; packaged password-manager/autofill proof stays in LSC-2P.
